chunks: And indeed, the two sons of Fatimah have from the charity (sadaqah) of Ali the same share as the sons of Ali. And I have only assigned the administration of that to the two sons of Fatimah, seeking the pleasure of Allah, and nearness to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and honoring his sanctity, and elevating his kinship.

key_terms.صَدَقَةِ عَلِيٍّ: The charitable estate or endowment of Ali

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling regarding the inheritance or administration of Imam Ali's sadaqah for his sons?
ai.summary: In this pivotal clause of his will, Imam Ali designates Hasan and Husayn as the primary administrators of his sadaqah, a decision deeply rooted in the Shia doctrine of the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual and material precedence. By linking this administrative authority to 'seeking nearness' (qurbah) to the Prophet, he elevates their role from mere legal heirs to custodians of his legacy, reinforcing the theological concept of their unique closeness to divine authority.
